name: o73969

schema.title: GIS_object
schema.description: A GIS object is an application defined type that owns GIS coordinates

gis.description: Definition of an object that owns GIS coordinates. At minimum an object of this type owns one of the props

description:
Dear Team,

Please find below the GIS definition for the new study area in Berlin. The central reference point is defined as **POINT (13.4050 52.5200)**. The full extent of the area is captured by the polygon **POLYGON ((13.4000 52.5000, 13.5000 52.5000, 13.5000 52.6000, 13.4000 52.6000, 13.4000 52.5000))**, which outlines the boundaries we will be analysing. Additionally, the proposed travel corridor within this zone follows the route **LINESTRING (13.4000 52.5000, 13.4500 52.5500, 13.5000 52.6000)**.

Kindly incorporate these coordinates into your spatial models and let me know if any adjustments are required.
